name: Wraithaxe
description: An axe said to be able to cut shadows.

name: Starry Halberd
description: A golden spear with not just one, but seven spearheads. It can be used to pierce and simultaneously tear the skin of opponents.

name: Misery Dark Serpent
description: Mid-tier sword used as a secondary weapon by ninjas.

name: Erosion Staff
description: A dangerous magic staff that can only be used for malevolent purposes, specifically to cause natural disasters. Only a chosen wielder can activate its power.

name: Quartz Yucca
description: A rare yucca leaf that grows on quartz rocks. It is often used by knights who hunt in dark places. With this accessory, they don't have to fear losing their way because of its glowing green light in the dark.

name: Seaborn Carapace (Rear View)
description: A shell taken from the defeated Hatchy Speartle.

name: Aximo
description: A diminutive axe of reserve, adorned with a touch of elegance on its metal edge, designed to please the eye.

name: Vigilia Backshield
description: A backshield placed on the back is usually worn by ordinary soldiers.

name: Crux
description: A conventional sword with a curved quillon, characterized by its elegant simplicity.

name: Rigor Backshield
description: A lighter and more flexible backshield, surpassing the Vigilia Backshield in its agility, yet commanding a slightly higher price.

name: Fiery Reaper
description: Fiery scythe gained after spiritbonding with Scythepaw

name: Seaborn Carapace
description: A shell taken from the defeated Hatchy Speartle.

name: Candlekin Head Shield
description: A head taken from the defeated Hatchy Candlekin, slightly modified to become a shield.

name: Green Gladius
description: An accessory taken from the defeated Hatchy Carathorn, slightly modified to become an additional weapon for protecting the back.

name: Hypnos Staff
description: A magic staff taken from the defeated Hatchy Hypnoshade.

name: Ephises
description: A sword taken from the defeated Hatchy Emberslash.

name: Sixsoul Tail
description: A tail taken from the defeated Hatchy Seraph.

name: Entwined Hand Tendril
description: An accessory taken from the defeated Hatchy Mancia.

name: Courageuse Totem
description: A totem taken from the defeated Hatchy Tronk.

name: Aegis Exosuit
description: A Robe made of special silk that can store light energy. provides resistance to dark element

name: Akki Armor
description: capable of minimizing the damage inflicted by Void-element

name: Arcane Raiment
description: Arcane Raiment is often used by wizard who want greater access to magic energy. Using this outfit, a wizard will gain greater power than usual. However, it should be noted, that without his Arcane necklace, his powers would not have appeared.

name: Arcanium Rune
description: Clothing worn by nobility when attending events. it uses runes to store artifacts or magic cards secretly

name: Nimbus Nighthawk Armor
description: A stylish armor made from the claws of Hatchies of all elements. It pairs perfectly with weapons capable of harnessing the power of wind. It doubles the damage for any weapon with wind magic.

name: Ashen Oak Vestments
description: The armor worn by the lower-ranking members of The Order.
story_notes:
The Order
-This armor is not very visible because members of The Order typically cover their bodies with long hooded cloaks.

name: Aura Predator (Female)
description: The attire worn by merchants at the Hatchy Market. Nearly all the materials for this robe are sourced from Hatchy bodies. It has the ability to tame and make even the most ferocious Hatchies obedient.

name: Aura Predator (Male)
description: The attire worn by merchants at the Hatchy Market. Nearly all the materials for this robe are sourced from Hatchy bodies. It has the ability to tame and make even the most ferocious Hatchies obedient.

name: Auxilus Stormwing
description: Armor that can make its wearer lighten their body to the point of temporary levitation. To extend the duration of levitation, assistance is required, such as magic cards or artifacts with elements of wind.

name: Azure Battlegear
description: Armor that can be infused with Water-Elemental Crystals, making it a special "weapon" during battles. Often worn by Elite Water Knights.

name: Barbaric Arrigun
description: The ability to automatically multiply one's proficiency with all types of weapons is a feature of this armor. Many ordinary people also wear Barbaric Arrigun to be able to use weapons without the hassle of learning them from scratch.

name: Bukomon (Female)
description: The traditional attire commonly worn by the people of Achopior includes a variety of distinctive garments. One of the most frequently donned items by its citizens is a unique, culturally significant piece of clothing.

name: Bukomon (Male)
description: The traditional attire commonly worn by the people of Achopior includes a variety of distinctive garments. One of the most frequently donned items by its citizens is a unique, culturally significant piece of clothing.

name: Crimson Spellbreaker
description: Despite its name "Crimson," there is actually very little red color on this armor. The uniqueness of this armor lies in being the only one capable of preventing opponents from completing their incantations. It's as if there is a mysterious force that hinders opponents when they try to finish their incantations to attack the wearer of this armor.

name: Darkheart Cyor (Female)
description: The mysterious armor worn by The Order's followers. It exudes a dark and profound aura, so intense that even formidable Hatchy creatures would feel compelled to flee due to the overwhelming energy it radiates.

name: Darkheart Cyor (Male)
description: The mysterious armor worn by The Order's followers. It exudes a dark and profound aura, so intense that even formidable Hatchy creatures would feel compelled to flee due to the overwhelming energy it radiates.

name: Dragoneers Blood Moon (Female)
description: One of the nine legendary armors. A fire-elemental armor reportedly used by dragon riders in the past. What makes this armor special is that some of its materials are taken from the "secret" parts of the Taurrid Hatchy's body.

name: Dragoneers Blood Moon(Male)
description: One of the nine legendary armors. A fire-elemental armor reportedly used by dragon riders in the past. What makes this armor special is that some of its materials are taken from the "secret" parts of the Taurrid Hatchy's body.

name: Emberstorm Armor
description: Neutral armor designed to diminish the impact of attacks from all elemental types. Perfect for hunting Hatchies of any element.

name: Flutterflight Skin Exosuit
description: Clothing inspired by Hatchy Flutterflight, as it provides warmth around the neck area. Despite being named Flutterflight, none of the materials are sourced from there. It is a garment reserved exclusively for individuals of high social status.

name: Britium Cuirass
description: Armor crafted from Britium for its lightness and durability, the wearer's body feels as if they're not wearing heavy armor and can move gracefully as if unburdened

name: Gevax Lodestone
description: Unique armor made primarily from magnets, but its main ability is to repel all attacks made of iron. Ordinary swords will be unable to harm the wearer of this armor, as if there is a powerful energy field that cannot be touched.

name: Nebula Plate
description: Unbelievably light yet durable, its made from an unknown material, not from this world

name: Heart of the Volcano
description: "Heart of the Volcano" is an extremely rare armor that, in legend, is said to only appear if someone manages to conquer the guardian of the Fire Temple. In the records of the modern era, no one is said to possess it. However, in the historical records of the ancient era, this armor was owned by someone.

name: Pirates' Parley Hauberk
description: While it appears comfortable and charming when worn, it is perilous as it is typically donned by high-ranking pirates. The fur collar cleverly conceals poisonous needles.

name: Decimator Strider Armor
description: Armor of desert pirates who use modified, battered vehicles. The armor is Light despite being made of Heavy Metal and provides significant protection for the Rider

name: Brithael Warrior Vestments
description: The ceremonial garb of The Order's esteemed women leaders. Exquisitely designed for sacred rituals, yet forged with the resilience for fierce combat.

name: Armor of the New Somola King
Space Rescue Division's Armor (Male)
description: An armor whose name has become legendary for traversing the stars and saving countless lives in space.

name: Space Rescue Division's Armor (Female)
description: An armor whose name has become legendary for traversing the stars and saving countless lives in space.

name: Gleeful Behemoth Attire
description: Crafted from the Behemoth, it has the ability to raise the wearers luck

name: Buzzkill's Breastplate
description: Highly territorial, Buzzkill becomes furious when another Buzzkill invades its domain. Armor crafted from Buzzkill remains is ideal for mental combat training. Paired with the Buzzkill magic card, it grants the wearer abnormal physical strength.

name: Emperor Crabemoth
description: Defying the conventions of human armor crafting, this legendary armor is said to have been forged in the deepest, darkest parts of the ocean. It is believed to be worn by dragon riders who reign over the seas.

name: Chancellor’s Ornate Garb
description: A gracefully adorned garb, exuding elegance and authority, symbolizing a high office and significant responsibilities. Typically worn by the royal treasurer.

name: Drakonian Float Armor
description: An armor infused with shards of esoteric artifacts from Drakonia, granting the wearer the ability to levitate. This extraordinary power comes at a cost, significantly draining their energy.

name: Chunky Knit Sweater
description: A thickly knitted sweater, offering extra warmth and comfort for women, perfect for embracing the cold with style and coziness.

name: Pumpkin Spice Tee
description: An elegant orange women's tee, radiating vibrant energy and perfect for making a bold fashion statement.

name: Navy Blue Pullover Hoodie
description: A blue pullover hoodie that's perfect for outdoor activities.

name: Red-Black Mock Neck Jacket
description: A stylish jacket with a slightly high collar, featuring an eye-catching combination of red and black.

name: Open-Front Hoodie with Fur Collar
description: A stylish and warm fur collar hoodie, perfect for women with a youthful spirit.

name: Gray T-shirt
description: Men's T-shirt in sophisticated gray.

name: Red Tank Top
description: Men's tank top in red.

name: Blazing Chill Jacket
description: This red jacket is perfect for both chill days and workout sessions - it's a great all-around choice!

name: Semi-Winter Jacket
description: A semi-winter jacket seamlessly blending the elements of nature with cutting-edge technology.

name: Timeless Charcoal Blazer
description: Radiating elegance that commands trust and credibility – truly a must-have addition to every man's collection.

name: Iron Legion Guard
description: Basic starter armor commonly used by novice warriors. Also worn by warriors on a tight budget

name: Kilas Tenabres (Female)
description: An incredibly powerful armor, feared by all creatures on Earth. It possesses a multitude of abilities and is only held by individuals who attain the status of Grandknight, the highest rank within the knight hierarchy.

name: Kilas Tenabres (Male)
description: An incredibly powerful armor, feared by all creatures on Earth. It possesses a multitude of abilities and is only held by individuals who attain the status of Grandknight, the highest rank within the knight hierarchy.

name: Lepirox Valor
description: Not meant for combat, but this armor is worn by medical personnel to ward off illnesses caused by sick Hatchies. This armor can repel diseases that may attempt to spread from sick Hatchies to humans.

name: Luminous Sea Armor
description: The armor commonly worn by warriors when navigating the seas. This armor allows its user to breathe underwater, although not for extended periods. Another advantage is that it does not make the wearer sink due to its weight but instead makes them agile in the water.

name: Lunar Demonplate (Female)
description: An armor so terrifying it can only be donned by those with profound knowledge, be it advanced magic or high-level Tongenkyo. It possesses the power to subdue even the dark elements of Hatchy.

name: Lunar Demonplate (Male)
description: An armor so terrifying it can only be donned by those with profound knowledge, be it advanced magic or high-level Tongenkyo. It possesses the power to subdue even the dark elements of Hatchy.

name: Trainee's Plate
description: common training garment imbued with its own sensing crystal on the chest that flickers when the wearer runs out of Mana.
story_notes: Often used by archers who heavily rely on enchanted arrows rather than using regular arrows.

name: Mighty Midnightscars (Female)
description: An armor imbued with malevolent energy and shrouded in an aura of dark magic. Only the mighty are capable of donning this armor, and its wearers are exclusively the war generals of The Order organization. They stand one tier below Darkheart Cyor.
story_notes: its wearers are exclusively the war generals of The Order organization. They stand one tier below Darkheart Cyor

name: Mighty Midnightscars (Male)
description: An armor imbued with malevolent energy and shrouded in an aura of dark magic. Only the mighty are capable of donning this armor, and its wearers are exclusively the war generals of The Order organization. They stand one tier below Darkheart Cyor.

name: Molten Haqoro
description: Armor made from "molten rock." Its creation can only be performed by stone-melting magic. The name Haqoro itself was chosen because before it was known as "Ixor, City of Chants," the place was called the Village of Haqoro.

name: Persanare (Female)
description: The attire worn by members of a mysterious cult who believe that Omni is the true God. It is typically worn when the members gather in their special temple.

name: Persanare (Male)
description: The attire worn by members of a mysterious cult who believe that Omni is the true God. It is typically worn when the members gather in their special temple.

name: Phrilea
description: Phrilea is a gown bestowed upon someone who has successfully graduated and been officially registered in the Union of Priest Associations. The primary raw material of Phrilea is the hair of Pegasus Hatchies, carefully and lovingly trimmed.

name: Swiftwing Protector
description: The "Swiftwing" is worn by warriors who prioritize speed and mobility for aggressive fighting styles. It is often worn by fearless heroes who are unafraid to confront death.

name: Radiance Astral
description: The armor worn by female witch employees at the Union of Wizard Associations office. It is capable of enhancing all magical attacks with all elements.

name: Red Draconic Armor
description: Specialized armor designed for the members of the Chambra Temple. This armor assists in activating the seven dormant chakras within the human body, allowing the wearer to unleash a hidden power known as Tongenkyo.

name: Seraphic Eclipse
description: The armor worn by male knight employees at the Union of Knight Associations office. It has the ability to enhance all physical attacks and minimize the impact of attacks from magic of all elements.

name: Seraphic Valor
description: The armor worn by female knight employees at the Union of Knight Associations office. It has the ability to enhance all physical attacks and minimize the impact of attacks from magic of all elements.

name: Spring of Sol Assault
description: An armor that is highly renowned due to its role in a significant historical war event in modern history. If a Hatchy Master and their Hatchy simultaneously attack the wearer of this armor, the weakest attack will have an impact on the wearer. Stronger attacks will mysteriously rebound.

name: Sterling Omnibus
description: The attire worn in the central bank of Ixor. it has many hidden pockets

name: Stormcaller Enigma (Female)
description: The armor renowned for its ability to manipulate storms. One of the nine legendary armors.

name: Stormcaller Enigma (Male)
description: The armor renowned for its ability to manipulate storms. One of the nine legendary armors.

name: Talily
description: The armor worn by female priest employees at the Union of Priest Associations office. It has the ability to regenerate its wearer and can minimize the effects of dark magic.

name: The Pillar Of Domari
description: Specialized armor of the Domari Ice Guard. Imbued with special runes that increase Ice Magic
effects: particularly effective when combined with ice-type magic cards
story_notes: The guards of the Primary Temple in the city of Domari believe that dragons are not extinct. That's why they wear clothing with dragon symbols on the front, hoping that the dragons will rise again.

name: Trinket Swagger
description: Trinket Swagger is an armor whose name is the result of a nickname given by the inhabitants of Artaria. There is only one in the world, and it can only be owned and used by the Queen of the Kingdom of Artaria. It has three slots to store magic cards.
story_notes: Queen of the Kingdom of Artaria

name: Vanqhuiser Guardian
description: The armor worn by the leader of the Hydar Kingdom's army.
story_notes: leader of Hydar kingdom Army - General

name: Vasukani Pride
description: An armor that has emerged only in recent years and was created by a sword expert who is also a Grandknight named Isilron.

name: Venomous Alchemist
description: A garment donned by alchemists specializing in poisons, this armor can be infused with resistance potions, rendering the wearer immune to venom.

name: Vovelgoth
description: The armor worn by the warriors in the country of Akwar.

name: War of Iph
description: Originally just regular clothing with a few ornaments added to make it a simple armor. The War of Iph itself was a conflict that took place in the Doppelganger Forest, which was an unusual war as the forces that arrived there were fighting against creatures resembling themselves. The war abruptly ended due to an untimely tsunami that immediately destroyed the two warring factions.

name: Warden Valkryie
description: Although in ancient tales, Valkyries were a race consisting only of females, this concept has changed with the embodiment of Valkyrie spirit in the Warden Valkyrie attire. Only males are allowed to wear this garment, and they are the ones responsible for guarding the prison.

name: Wyrmfire Battlegear
description: Fire-elemental armor crafted through an extreme process. It is made by being placed in a special container and immersed in volcanic lava for several days. Only artisans with special certification are capable of creating it.

name: Purple Monk Hood (Male)
description: The hood commonly worn during religious activities.

name: Purple Monk Hood (Female)
description: The hood commonly worn during religious activities.

name: Purple Hood (Male)
description: The hood used to protect the head from the scorching sun or cold weather.
effects:
resistance to cold
resistance to light

name: Purple Hood (Female)
description: The hood used to protect the head from the scorching sun or cold weather.
effects:
resistance to cold
resistance to light

name: Schattenkrone
description: A rare and expensive crown. It is crafted from a special material extracted using forbidden magic to emulate the power of Hatchy Abydon. Much like Abydon's abilities, the wearer of this crown can generate mist around them, and Schattenkrone users can also perceive everything concealed within the mist.

name: Tiara Anemos
description: The crown is intended for women. Anyone can use this crown, but the condition is that the wearer must have an official certification from a specific organization. It can conjure the magic of the wind.

name: Nebular Crown
description: Unbelievably light yet durable, its made from an unknown material, not from this world

name: Regalia of the Mystic Aurora
description: The crown is shaped like a bird with outstretched wings. It is made from the finest artifacts not available in the market, and obtaining it requires risking one's life. It possesses extraordinary energy.

name: Feline's Maschera
description: An open-faced mask taking the silhouette of a tiger, used by female warriors who rely on speed in combat.

name: Tygron's Maschera
description: Similar to the Feline's Maschera, but its user is male. It serves the same function as the female version, enhancing speed both in combat and running.

name: PurityMask
description: The face shield is used by a considerable number of middle-class warriors belonging to any kingdom, due to its affordable price and decent quality.

name: Sentinel Head Protector
description: A common head protector.

name: Scorchrex Mask
description: A mask crafted by an Infernoforge, capable of inducing terrifying hallucinations, where all living creatures in front of the wearer appear as fire monsters ready to attack. This mask is sealed and stored within the Chambra Temple.

name: QuantumGaze
description: A mask imbued with Void-Element Runes. Ideal for users specialized in Void-Elemental Hatchy Masters

name: Shadowmere Baraq
description: commonly Light-element headgear. increases light-elemental effectiveness

name: Tiara of the Astrapai
description: A tiara that is exceptionally well-suited for hunting Hatchy in dark places like caves or forests that are completely shrouded in darkness due to its ability to emit light from the gem at its center. It is primarily used by warriors, wizards, or Hatchy Masters ranging from beginner to intermediate levels.

name: Diadem of the Radiant Dawn
description: Highly compatible when combined with Radiance Astral, it will cause its user to have multiplied strength. Often used by female knights, though quite frequently worn by non-knight female warriors with less noble intentions.

name: Eyes of Ether
description: A device highly valued for its ability to see the flow of energy within a weapon, be it a sword, magic wand, dagger, arrow, or even a shield. It enables the user to anticipate the element used by their opponent.

name: Tuxedo's Quest
description: A tuxedo mask available in the country of Artaria, sold as a souvenir item. Often used at royal parties.

name: Lunatic Hypnoptic
description: Used by knights and even Grandknights to protect them from illusion attacks that target vision.

name: Oceanic Glasses
description: hatchy armor

name: EliteEye Monocle
description: A monocle commonly used for examining the composition of an object. However, in the hands of a skilled craftsman, this monocle can enable its wearer to see the energy present within the bodies of living creatures.

name: ForestDream EyePatch
description: An eye patch that is typically worn by warriors in training to sharpen their hearing, but is also used by blind individuals to cover their damaged eyes so they are not seen by others.

name: Lapis Tenabres (Male)
description: The special cowl that can only be worn by the Grandknight because it can enhance all the power of the Grandknight wearing it. Its energy will multiply exponentially when paired with the Kilas Tenabres.

name: Long Red Farmer Hatband
description: A hatband used to protect the head from hot weather. Magic cards cannot be attached.

name: Iron Demon Kettle Hat
description: Although it looks simple, this helmet is commonly used by paladins in battle. Highly recommended for knights with high status.

name: Leaf Village Bycocket
description: A bycocket woven directly in Leaf Village, and can be used by both knights and common folk.

name: Midnightscars Barbute (Male)
description: The barbute worn by war generals in the Order, especially when engaging in large-scale battles. It is resistant to hypnosis and all forms of hallucinatory magic.

name: Harmony Horns
description: Horn accessories resembling dove wings, commonly used for festivals. Made from high-quality buffalo bone.

name: ShadowFlap Horns
description: Horn accessories resembling bat wings, commonly used for festivals. Made from teak wood and special ceramic.

name: Royal Antlers
description: Special horn accessories resembling deer antlers, commonly used for festivals. Made from sandalwood and combined with horn powder from Hatchy Elkar to add authority.

name: Mystishroud Mask
description: Gives the wearer the ability to summon a sudden enveloping mist

name: Chriothik Necromancer
description: Crafted from 3 different Dark-element organs of Hatchy: Baphomet, Hypnoshade, and Murcial, this mask ranks among legendary masks. It possesses a high-level poison element, and strangely, it is believed to have the ability to resurrect the dead.

name: Ancient Bullveil Protector
description: A Mask made from Doom Horn and Abysit that can increase the hardness level of the armor worn on the body. despite its tiny size, its extremely heavy

name: Ixor Commanders Regalia
description: Ixor National Airguard Commanders Helm

name: Mystikos Mors
description: The sacred crown of the knights that has the power to infuse ordinary weapons with magic. However, if this crown is removed during a battle, the weapons held by the knights can revert to being ordinary weapons. Therefore, it is advised to use it with caution.

name: Crown of the Whispering Void
description: Used by the high-ranking members of The Order to distinguish themselves from their subordinates. It can ward off attacks of magic from all elements and can enhance the user's attacks, especially void-elemental magic.

name: Behemoth Crown
description: behemoth helmet

name: Glimmering Circos
description: A face protector originating from Old Port. There is a sense of pride when using this face protector, as it is filled with stories of battles against evil.

name: Iron Legion Mask
description: A mask resembling an owl. Typically worn by Hatchy Masters who enjoy riding flying Hatchies.

name: Fury Chaotic Helm
description: A special helmet for the high ranking Order members, gives increased power and the chance to curse opponents

name: Forgotten Grimoire
description: A cruel, Cursed mask made from Shadarkan, processed before the fire was extinguished

name: Estranged Chaotic Helm
description: An Ancient form of the Fury Chaotic Helm, this prototype was said to eventually take control of the wearers mind

name: Parados Starless
description: At first, the horns on this mask shone brightly as they were made from the horns of Hatchy Elkar, but the wearer of this mask has fallen into darkness and can never return. Therefore, the color of this mask has completely changed.

name: Wingrider Helm
description: mounted wingrider soldiers helmet

name: Sovereign of the Abyssos Daemonium
description: It is believed that anyone who wears this crown will be able to summon Felkyn, the god. To this day, no one knows who made it and what it is made of.

name: Waldgeist Krone
description: The crown is worn by Sharian Aelrindel, the King of the Fairies in the forest where the Leaf Temple is situated. It possesses the secret magic of the forest and makes its wearer resistant to attacks from stone-made weapons.

name: Nocturnus Terror
description: legendary dark helmet

name: Acolyte Visage (Female)
description: The mask of the lower-ranked members of The Order during ceremonies to avoid recognition

name: Acolyte Visage (Male)
description: The mask of the lower-ranked members of The Order during ceremonies to avoid recognition

name: Serpentine Face Mask
description: A mysterious mask. Its origins are unknown. Its purpose, too, remains a mystery.

name: Silentium Mask
description: Mouth masks often used by knights who do not wish to reveal their identities. Also used by ninjas.

name: Duck Beak Mask
description: monster mouth guard

name: Dragonbreath Chin Guard
description: This chin guard is typically worn by blacksmiths to protect their chin while crafting weapons, but some knights have begun popularizing it in combat tournaments.

name: Anti Plaguebringer
description: Mouth masks exclusively worn by 'gatekeepers' of dungeons filled with Hatchy capable of emitting poison. Used as a sign for novice Hatchy hunters that the dungeon is filled with deadly toxins.

name: Agrucium Mask
description: Modern mouth mask commonly used by Hatchy hunters in dense forests. Aids in camouflage within the forest.

name: Muzzle of the Ghost
description: It is believed that the spirits of the warriors continue to scream in pain after death, so this mask is made to cover the mouths of the bodies of the warriors. However, since that legend is no longer popular, these mouth masks are now widely used by warriors and Hatchy hunters.

name: Sandcurse Mask
description: Mouth mask used by ninjas who typically operate in sandy and rocky areas. Allows the wearer to breathe comfortably even during sandstorms.

name: Hegralt Patch
description: Accessories worn on the nose and chin. Famous in the southern mainland.

name: Costume Blade
description: Costume Headgear worn at parties

name: Sky Wings Shoulderplates
description: If used near a temple (any temple), this shoulder armor will automatically make the arms feel lighter and more free when swinging a weapon.

name: Icicle Shoulderplates
description: Shoulderplates that are suitable for use alongside water-element armor or armor equipped with ice magic cards.

name: Yellow River Shoulderplates
description: This shoulder armor is highly appealing to beauty enthusiasts due to its vibrant yellow color. It's sturdy and reasonably priced.

name: Indigo Diviner Shoulderplates
description: Used by knights with high-energy magic weapons, as this shoulder armor stores powerful energy.

name: Nebular Protectors
description: Unbelievably light yet durable, its made from an unknown material, not from this world

name: Chivalric Shoulderplates
description: The wearer of this shoulder armor is synonymous with someone who is steadfast in knightly values.

name: Epaulets of the Red Valley
description: Shoulder guards worn by high-ranking individuals in Chambra Temple. Believe it or not, those seemingly dense feathers are made from plants.

name: Bluewave Brigand Shoulderplates
description: Although its name may seem "evil," many fighters from various backgrounds wear these shoulder plates. They are suitable for use when sailing the seas.

name: Jadu Jars
description: Shoulder guards that provide protection against poison and potion attacks.

name: Trainee's Pauldrons
description: Light Element training armor commonly used for combat training and sparring for its light-weight and durability

name: Nimbus Nighthawk Shoulderplates
description: Inspired by dragon tales, this shoulder armor is given a unique name to battle dragons in legend.

name: Emberstorm Shoulder Guards
description: A simple yet well crafted armor, sturdy and reliable

name: Unyielding Shoulderplates
description: Shoulder armor made of metal and a mixture of stones with hardness levels surpassing those of common stones.

name: Ironstorm Shoulder Guards
description: There is a legend that says this shoulder armor was once tested to be struck by a magical sword with tremendous energy, yet it remained unscathed.

name: Luminous Verdant Shoulderplates
description: Strong and sturdy, this shoulder armor is widely available in the market. The inclusion of small horn variations taken from the body of Hatchy Blitzard makes its price expensive. It is used by a noble knight named Luminous.

name: Heraldic Knight's Shoulderplates
description: These shoulder plates are specifically designed for use by knights. If used by anyone other than a knight, the true energy will not arise.

name: Regalia of the Golden Realm
description: One of the rare artifacts, the golden regalia, is the main material of this shoulder armor, making it one of the sought-after items by many, including heavyweight criminals. It harbors mysterious power.

name: Ornamental Golden-Fang Shoulder Guard
description: Displaying elegance, many are deceived by its seemingly useless form in battle, although for those in the know, these Shoulder Guards falls under the category of "Dangerous Goods"

name: Knight's Legacy Protector
description: Similar to some other knight shoulder armors, but this shoulder armor is more popular in the Holy Badlands.

name: Ethermesh Shoulder Armor
description: This shoulder armor is rarely used for combat, as it's typically worn by guards of goods. However, its durability is noteworthy.

name: Tectonic Templar Shoulderplates
description: Enhancing resilience against earth-element attacks and capable of signaling impending earthquakes, this shoulder armor is popular in earthquake-prone areas.

name: Shoulder Guards of the Minotorch
description: Made from pure steel and adorned with Minotorch feathers as decoration, this shoulder armor is sold at a high price in the market.

name: Chelong Zeto
description: Used by low-class warriors and sometimes also worn by civilians preparing for battle. Besides its white color resembling rice, rice is also considered a commoner's food.

name: Eala Aghiad
description: Commonly used by female knights, but also often utilized by witches if deemed necessary. It enables hand regeneration when injured because it is mixed with wings from Hatchy Pixelite.

name: Ancient Crystal Ranger Shoulderplates
description: The legendary shoulder armor reportedly worn by the Ancient Water Temple guards

name: Albian
description: Light-element shoulder armor, increasing resistance against Light attacks.

name: Shoulderguard of the pumpkin king F
Wraithaxe
